about_the_game:
A grim business, playing the assassin... That sort of work stays with a person, even after all the killing is done. But blood washes from coin easy enough, eh?

Includes:

  • 1000 Platinum

  • Niccolo Bird Pet cosmetic*

Platinum can be exchanged to customize your in-game experience with purchasable cosmetic items from the Shop and to unlock access to the Deluxe Battle Pass Bundle and the Premium Battle Pass Bundle.
